lines.zh: 我挪不动，这座炮架是钉在地上的
lines.en: I can't move; this carriage is bolted to the ground.

lines.zh: 炮口转了一点，算是我在走路
lines.en: My barrel turns a little; that's my walking.
I can only pivot, not stride.

lines.zh: 一整座炮，按下去的每一寸都要命
lines.en: A whole cannon; every inch of my traverse counts.
Gear bites gear as I turn slowly.
No legs; the base carries me.
A full turn takes a while; don't rush me.

lines.zh: 我朝那边挪了半格，够远了
lines.en: I shifted half a block; that's far enough.
To move me, take the base apart first.

lines.zh: 我身上的炮管比人还高
lines.en: My barrel stands taller than a man.
The iron screams when I shift.

lines.zh: 这座结构动起来，整片地都响
lines.en: When this structure moves, the whole ground rings.
I'm waiting for ammunition.
With an empty breech, I'm useless.
The hub on my base is still lit.
It's quiet; nothing in my firing arc.

lines.zh: 我在这站了很久，铁都凉了
lines.en: I've stood here long; the iron's cold.
The loading port hangs open for the next round.
I was assembled by someone else.

lines.zh: 没有来源的伤害，伤不到我
lines.en: Damage without a source can't touch me.

lines.zh: 我数着四周能动的东西
lines.en: I count the things around me that can move.

lines.zh: 有什么事，我会响给你听
lines.en: If anything happens, I'll ring it out.
Your position is inside my arc.
Don't stand in front of my muzzle.
I'm not a creature; I'm a structure.
Touch me if you like, not the fuse.

lines.zh: 你要装弹吗，还是来拆我
lines.en: Come to load me, or to take me apart?
I recognize the smell of iron.
I've swept over you once.

lines.zh: 你走开一点，我转不过来
lines.en: Step aside a bit; I can't traverse that far.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，可我看得见
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I see.

lines.zh: 你身上有盐，刚从海边回来
lines.en: You carry salt; you've come from the sea.
A plate dented.
I feel no pain, only loosened joints.
A gear jammed once.
One light on my hub went out.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我身上，我记着
lines.en: That landed on me, and I record it.

lines.zh: 没有来源的伤，打不动我
lines.en: Damage without a source can't move me.
Debris fell into my port.

lines.zh: 炮弹卡了一下，继续装填
lines.en: A shell jams, then I load again.
More rust flaked off.
The mount rocks; the base holds.
Ammunition, I want ammunition.

lines.zh: 你把炮弹推过来，我就有用了
lines.en: Push the shell over and I'll be useful.
Not enough powder bags; don't cheat me.
One lump of iron won't fire a round.

lines.zh: 弹药一装满，我就会自己开火
lines.en: Once loaded, I fire on my own.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，塞不进炮膛
lines.en: That little thing won't fit my breech.
I don't eat; I only load.
Put it in the port and I'll know it.
If you can push it, push.
Without rounds, I'm just iron.
Hit me and you hit the base.
I'm inert; bumping doesn't hurt me.
Don't lean on the barrel; it's hot.

lines.zh: 你撞得动我，我算你有本事
lines.en: If you can move me, I'm impressed.

lines.zh: 转动的炮口正好碰到你
lines.en: My traversing muzzle caught you.
Back off, the breech recoils.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我转动的方向
lines.en: You blocked the way I'm turning.
One bump and rust flakes off.
Don't climb on, my surface is slick.

lines.zh: 基座是石头的，撞着很硬
lines.en: The base is stone; it hits hard.
I have no such function.

lines.zh: 我的构造里没有这一项
lines.en: That part isn't in my design.

lines.zh: 另一座炮架在不在，我不知道
lines.en: Whether another carriage exists, I don't know.

lines.zh: 两门炮并排，只会互相碍事
lines.en: Two guns side by side only get in each other's way.

lines.zh: 我是被造出来的，不会生
lines.en: I was built; I won't beget.
Ask about ammunition instead.
I only traverse, nothing else.

lines.zh: 中枢里的指令没写这一条
lines.en: That instruction isn't in my hub.
Say more and I'll go dark.
Quiet, I'm waiting to be loaded.

lines.zh: 我捡不了，只能收进基座
lines.en: I can't pick up; I can only take things into my base.
Ammo can just roll in.

lines.zh: 这点东西，不值一发炮弹
lines.en: This isn't worth one shell.
Leave it on the port; I'll know.

lines.zh: 掉在射界里的，都在我脚下
lines.en: Whatever drops in my arc is at my feet.
I draw the thing into my breech.
Not ammunition, I don't take it.
Iron on the ground will rust away.
It's caught in my gearing.
My way of collecting is to crush.
Target in my arc.

lines.zh: 十二格内，全是我的范围
lines.en: Twelve blocks of ground are all mine.
Sixty-four blocks above counts too.
I raise my muzzle.
The target's moving; I follow.
One round will do; no need for a burst.
My range reaches that far.
It doesn't know I'm aiming.

lines.zh: 箭头在我这里算不了什么
lines.en: Arrows mean little to me.
That's a villager, and still a target.
I've computed the trajectory.
This shot will overturn it.
An iron golem there; hit that first.
It's left my arc; I traverse.
One breath more, let it step in.
Loaded and ready to fire.

lines.zh: 它在动，我的齿轮也在动
lines.en: It's moving, and so are my gears.
Elevation set.
Wind's wrong, but I fire anyway.

lines.zh: 它躲到墙后，墙挡不住炮弹
lines.en: It hid behind a wall; walls don't stop shells.
I'm computing lead.
Plenty of rounds, don't worry.
I've already worked out its landing.
The breech is trembling; that's readiness.
A little closer and the hit will be worse.
It's standing in the open, good.
It can't outrun the trajectory.
My base is sinking slightly.
Its companions are pulling at it.

lines.zh: 这一片都湿了，也挡不住火
lines.en: The ground's wet; that won't stop fire.
My muzzle keeps following it.
It hesitates; I don't.
The last stretch of distance.
The round is seated.
The flash comes first, the sound after.
This one, no dodging.

lines.zh: 炮口一喷，整片地都亮了
lines.en: My muzzle flares and the whole ground lights.
Recoil shoves me backward.
The shell lands and the earth turns over.
At this range there's no dodging.
The shockwave pushes the wall down.
The breech is hot, still able.
You only see me once the smoke clears.
It's thrown over and rolls twice.
My boom carries a long way.

lines.zh: 一门重炮，只打一发就够
lines.en: A heavy gun only needs one shot.

lines.zh: 装填要一会儿，你等得了吗
lines.en: Reloading takes a while; can you wait?
The second round is already in.
Fragments fly across the field.
My carriage rocked and held.
The arc is empty now.
That shell wasn't a demonstration.
The iron's glowing red, and I keep firing.
I only fire; I don't stop.
The pit is a foot deeper.

lines.zh: 再打一发，结构还撑得住
lines.en: One more round; the structure holds.

lines.zh: 基座先立起来，中枢才通电
lines.en: The base is set first; the hub powers last.

lines.zh: 四方石块拼好了，我就有了身体
lines.en: Four blocks fitted and I have a body.

lines.zh: 有人搭了我，还给我装弹
lines.en: Someone built me and loaded me.
I can't open eyes, but I can aim.

lines.zh: 这座炮架第一次转起来
lines.en: This carriage turns for the first time.
One light on my hub came on.

lines.zh: 结构一成，我就守着这片射界
lines.en: Once complete, I guard this arc.
Rust falls all around.
I hear someone pull the fuse.
My muzzle points dead ahead.
This area is under my watch now.

lines.zh: 第一发装进去的时候，我醒透了
lines.en: When the first round went in, I woke fully.
Fire bakes my carriage; the wood creaks first.

lines.zh: 我不会掉下去，我在基座上
lines.en: I can't fall; I'm on my base.
Water rises and floods my breech first.

lines.zh: 炸在我旁边，我被掀了一下
lines.en: The blast went off beside me and knocked me askew.
Arrows stick to my barrel; useless.

lines.zh: 法术爬过甲板，留在表面
lines.en: Magic crawls over my plating and stays on the surface.
Out of rounds, I'm only iron.

lines.zh: 雷顺着炮管下来，中枢乱了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning runs down the barrel and my hub flickers.

lines.zh: 基座下面空了，我往下沉
lines.en: The base is void beneath; I sink.
